name: Low Sun
description: A cone of low sunlight that sweeps in from a top corner, settles on your content and breathes slowly.

props.name: from
props.description: Where the light enters. The cone always points at the centre of the box.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the outer light. At night the core is mixed toward snow white; by day the cone is a pale wash of this colour.

props.name: size
props.description: Multiplier for the length and width of the cone.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the light sweeps in. The sweep takes about 1.5 seconds.

props.name: follow
props.description: Let the far end of the cone lean toward the pointer, through a spring, by up to 14 degrees.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the light. Other div props are passed through.
